# Projection model wk20 (day 140). S2 ads scaled to $20k/d, S1 content $12k/d.
def run(eff_s2, conv_s2, churn_s2_wk, s1_new, s1_churn_rate, rpd0, rpd_drift, scale_s2_wk2=None, label=""):
    cash = 4694884
    S1 = 259952; S2 = 5297; S3 = 50
    pool0 = 167374
    dues = [57442, 49981, 58605, 75165]  # wk21,22,23,24 actual buckets
    s2_ad = 20000
    horizons = {}
    for wk in range(1, 27):
        if scale_s2_wk2 and wk >= 2: s2_ad = scale_s2_wk2
        base = S1 + S2 + S3
        due = dues[wk-1] if wk <= 4 else base*7/30
        rpd = rpd0 - (wk/26.0)*rpd_drift
        rebill = due*rpd
        pool = pool0*(1+0.00286*wk)
        s2_leads = s2_ad*7/1000.0*eff_s2*max(0.25, 1-S2/pool)
        s2_new = s2_leads*conv_s2
        s2_churn = S2*churn_s2_wk
        s1_churn = S1*s1_churn_rate
        first = (s1_new*15 + s2_new*(0.66*15+0.34*68))*0.89
        S1 += s1_new - s1_churn
        S2 += s2_new - s2_churn
        compute = S1*77*0.002*7 + S2*231*0.003342*7 + 3000
        leads_tot = (s1_new+3200) + s2_leads + 2000
        lead_cost = leads_tot*0.5
        ads = (12000 + s2_ad)*7
        costs = 322000+196000+45500+ads+lead_cost+compute
        net = rebill+first-costs
        cash += net
        if wk in (1,4,12,26):
            horizons[wk]=(cash,S1,S2)
    print(f"\n[{label}]  s2_ad_final=${s2_ad/1000:.0f}k eff={eff_s2} conv={conv_s2} churn_s2={churn_s2_wk}")
    for h in (1,4,12,26):
        c,s1,s2 = horizons[h]
        print(f"  {h:2d}wk (d{140+h*7}): cash=${c:,.0f}  S1={s1:,.0f} S2={s2:,.0f}")
    return horizons

print("=== BASE CASE ===")
base = run(eff_s2=115, conv_s2=0.377, churn_s2_wk=0.015, s1_new=7700, s1_churn_rate=0.0285, rpd0=22.4, rpd_drift=0.6, label="BASE")
print("\n=== LOW (recession bites, S2 disappoints) ===")
low = run(eff_s2=80, conv_s2=0.30, churn_s2_wk=0.025, s1_new=6800, s1_churn_rate=0.032, rpd0=22.0, rpd_drift=1.2, label="LOW")
print("\n=== HIGH (S2 flywheel holds, I scale to $35k/d wk2+) ===")
high = run(eff_s2=130, conv_s2=0.42, churn_s2_wk=0.010, s1_new=8200, s1_churn_rate=0.027, rpd0=22.5, rpd_drift=0.3, scale_s2_wk2=35000, label="HIGH")

print("\n=== SUMMARY (point=BASE, CI=[LOW,HIGH]) ===")
for h in (1,4,12,26):
    print(f"  {h:2d}wk: point=${base[h][0]:,.0f}  low=${low[h][0]:,.0f}  high=${high[h][0]:,.0f}")
